snapshot._use: Persist fetched ticket + related tickets + linked Confluence pages to .specs/<ID>/04-artifacts/ticket/

paths._layers_use: Ordered inside-out [{name, path}] (innermost first); path may be a glob. Backs constitution 1.1 dependency direction. Filled by /sd:setup scan; [] when undetectable.

gates._comment: Descriptive only - no hook or command reads this block today; it documents each workflow's hard-gate sequence for humans/tooling that may consume it later.

escalation._ceiling_use: Highest alias escalation may reach. Set to 'sonnet' to cap cost on constrained quota.
escalation._comment: Per-invocation main-thread override. Agent frontmatter is never edited. Policy, trigger table and retro logging live in the sd-model-escalation skill. An absent block reads as enabled=true, ceiling=opus.

models._comment: Portable aliases (sonnet/haiku) — resolved to the current recommended version by Claude Code at runtime. Agents also use these aliases in frontmatter.

atlassian._use: Fetch JIRA tickets (+ related tickets and linked Confluence pages) in /sd:feature and /sd:bug

context7._use: Up-to-date library docs for sd-spec-architect and sd-implementer

sequential-thinking._use: Structured hypothesis enumeration in sd-debugger and sd-reviewer

gitnexus._use: Fast symbol search, callers, call graph for sd-code-explorer

database._use: Main thread only: read-only schema and query-plan inspection (SELECT/EXPLAIN only) with whichever database MCP tool this project provides (e.g. mssql, postgres). sd-debugger cannot call it - its tools allowlist is fixed - and reaches the database only through a read-only CLI client via Bash

tavily._use: Web search for error signatures / library issues in sd-debugger

userPromptRouter._use: Keyword routing + spec-context injection on every user prompt

specGate._modes: block = refuse Edit/Write on code without in-progress spec; warn = log to stderr only; off = skip
specGate._use: Guard rail blocking code edits when no spec is in-progress
specGate._verifyGate_use: Scoped to FEAT- (feature-spec) rows only - other types (bug, refactor, perf, rca, port) have no /sd:verify integration yet. true: a FEAT- row may transition to done only when <spec.dir>/<ID>/06-verify.md records 'result: pass' (written by /sd:verify); false: a FEAT- row can never be moved to done by an index.md edit. Every other index.md edit is decided by spec-gate Rule 0b (SW-75): new rows at draft/approved and Status-only moves along a workflow edge are allowed (including non-FEAT in-progress -> done); anything else stays blocked as a protected path.

subagentRetro._use: Reminder to update stale retros after subagent runs
subagentRetro._retroStaleMinutes_use: Default 30 - a guess, not tuned against a measured corpus (see docs/adr/0004-threshold-calibration.md). Re-calibrate per CONTRIBUTING's re-calibration ritual once enough closed specs accumulate.
subagentRetro._debounceMinutes_use: Default 10 - a guess, not tuned against a measured corpus (see docs/adr/0004-threshold-calibration.md). Re-calibrate per CONTRIBUTING's re-calibration ritual once enough closed specs accumulate.
subagentRetro._injectLessons_use: Surface lessons from <spec.dir>/_lessons/lessons.md when a subagent finishes work on an in-progress spec. Selection is by workflow type - a FEAT- spec pulls feature-scoped lessons - so there is no ranking. Emitted regardless of retro staleness and of debounceMinutes, which gate only the stale-retro reminder.
subagentRetro._maxLessons_use: Cap on NEW lessons surfaced per subagent stop. Already-surfaced lessons are recorded per session, so a session converges to silence rather than repeating itself. Set to 0 to surface none without disabling the reminder. Default 3 - a guess, not tuned against a measured corpus (see docs/adr/0004-threshold-calibration.md).

metrics._use: Append-only, metadata-only event log (no code content, no file paths) consumed by the retro loop. Set enabled=false to opt out entirely.
metrics._maxSizeKb_use: Soft byte cap (KB) for events.jsonl. When the live file reaches the cap, the next write rolls it to events.jsonl.1 (single generation, previous roll overwritten) and starts a fresh log. Default 1024 (~1MB, a guess - not tuned against a measured corpus); absent key also means 1024, so pre-existing configs stay bounded. Set to 0 to disable rotation and let the log grow unbounded. Rotation is best-effort: any failure (locked file, read-only dir) is a silent no-op and the hook never stops appending. events.jsonl.1 is a grace buffer, not part of any read contract - a consumer reads the live file only.
